newsitem.title: USA: World Bank okays 2nd tranche of Russian coal loan.
newsitem.headline: World Bank okays 2nd tranche of Russian coal loan.

text.p: The World Bank Monday approved release of the $250 million second tranche of a coal sector adjustment loan announced in June.

The bank said the funding is urgently needed and confirms that money made available under the program to date for support of the coal communities' housing and public utilities were delivered to the intended beneficiaries.
The Bank said an effective social program is essential to maintain support for the coal sector reform program. It approved the $500 million loan in June and disbursed the first half shortly after.
